key_highlights: ASX set to fall as oil passes US$109 and global bond yields surge, pressuring miners and banks
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
Australia softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears and supporting energy sector
Housing prices in correction with high-end hit hardest; first-home buyer activity surging
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
Copper and gold exploration activity strong; Flagship ups Canadian copper stakes
Power giant proposes AI data centres at coal plant sites, linking energy transition to tech demand
AUD shocker looms amid global yield spike and Chinese inflation surge

sectors.trend: Mixed: oil at US$109 supports energy miners (WDS.AX, WLE.AX), copper rally lifts Flagship (FLG.AX) and BHP.AX; gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) signals sustained precious metals interest. However, rising bond yields pressure commodity equities broadly.
sectors.implications: Energy and copper names outperform; iron ore (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) faces headwind from Chinese inflation data and potential demand slowdown. Gold miners (NVS.AX, GSG.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Negative: surging bond yields compress net interest margins; Bathla private credit collapse raises contagion fears. RBA rental inflation concern may delay rate cuts, supporting NIMs but capping credit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from yield volatility. Private credit exposure (via ASX-listed fund managers) warrants scrutiny. Super early-access debate (One Nation) could pressure APRA-regulated funds.

sectors.trend: Positive: Australia softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears. AI data centre demand at coal plant sites creates new revenue streams for generators. Oil at US$109 supports upstream.
sectors.implications: SAP.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from gas policy shift. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (AGL.AX, GPT.AX) offers transition narrative but raises ESG concerns.

sectors.trend: Housing correction underway with high-end prices falling steepest; first-home buyers surge. Woolworths breaches own Price Freeze, signalling cost-of-living pressure. RBA rental inflation focus pressures REIT valuations.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation and falling property values. Housing builders (MRG.AX, PNC.AX) may see volume support from first-home buyer surge.

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout at coal sites creates domestic demand. Alphabet's 20%+ revenue growth signals global tech strength. Crown Castle underperformance flags tower/infrastructure sector weakness.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data centre and power infrastructure names (VGE.AX, IAG.AX) benefit. Limited direct ASX tech exposure; global tech strength supports sentiment.

key_themes: Oil at US$109 and bond yield spike driving global risk-off
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Housing market bifurcation: high-end correction vs. affordable resilience
Gas policy liberalisation as strategic energy shift
AI data centre demand reshaping energy/infrastructure landscape
AUD vulnerability amid global yield divergence

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil at US$109 driving inflation and yield spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas (SAP.AX) over oil importers; monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rental inflation constraint delaying rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive REITs and housing builders; favour dividend-paying banks with NIM support

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bathla private credit collapse and contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review ASX-listed fund managers' private credit exposure; favour transparent, liquid instruments
Favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, FMG.AX) as natural AUD hedge; avoid import-heavy consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and NSW stamp duty revenue hit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor GPW.AX, ICPS.AX; favour affordable-housing REITs over premium; watch NSW fiscal policy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese inflation surge signalling demand slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce iron ore and thermal coal exposure; rotate to gold and copper with structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic gas and energy producers on policy liberalisation
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas reservation rules ease Asian supply fears; structural LNG demand supports pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper and gold exposure on commodity strength and exploration activity
opportunities.rationale: Copper rally, Flagship stake increase, and active gold-silver exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) signal sector tailwinds

opportunities.recommendation: Position in AI data centre / power infrastructure beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Coal-to-data-centre pivot creates new revenue; global AI capex cycle (Alphabet +20% rev) supports demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and thermal coal exposure amid Chinese inflation and yield spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Chinese demand risk and rising discount rates pressure commodity equities; oil at $109 diverts capital

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight premium REITs and high-end property; favour affordable housing plays
defensive_moves.rationale: High-end prices falling steepest; RBA rental inflation focus pressures valuations; NSW stamp duty hit signals fiscal stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure and avoid import-heavy consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk; Woolworths Price Freeze breach signals margin pressure on consumer names

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from oil at US$109, bond yield spike, and Bathla contagion. Expect ^AXJO to test support. Miners and banks lead declines. Gas and copper names provide relative strength. RBA rental inflation commentary keeps rate-cut expectations muted.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds in gas liberalisation, AI data centre demand, and copper/gold supply constraints support medium-term recovery. Housing correction may stabilise as first-home buyer surge supports volumes. Key risk is prolonged high oil driving global recession. RBA likely to hold rates, supporting bank NIMs but capping credit.

NSW budget and stamp duty revenue impact

ASX 200 sector rotation (energy vs materials vs financials)
